opening.argument: The speaker presents a time-limited OneCoin package as an active opportunity, stating that "The 555 limited package is a time-limited offer" and that it grants access to education and extended rights to practice, mine, and trade on the platform. The solicitation also builds participation through a business hierarchy: members are told to "Bring your prospects and join the revolution of finance and make it happen," while package codes can be collected and used to motivate others in the business. That combination of expiring package upgrades, platform access, recruitment, and rank-linked participation establishes an ongoing purchase and recruitment structure. The supplied material does not show a completed loss, but it does show a direct solicitation to buy packages, upgrade access, recruit prospects, accumulate codes, and pursue associated benefits.

citations.quote: The 555 limited package is a time-limited offer
This exclusive offer grants access to all 6 levels of Modular Financial Education and gives extended rights in the OneCoin platform to practice, mine, and trade.
Bring your prospects and join the revolution of finance and make it happen.
a great way to drive your business is by collecting free package codes, codes that you can use yourself or utilize to motivate others in your business.
